Version Control

Dấu đánh dấu xung đột

A visual indicator in files generated by version control systems during merge conflicts, marking the boundaries of conflicting code regions that must be resolved before a commit can proceed.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ITIL v4, AWS Well-Architected Framework, Kubernetes Documentation, CNCF and published by Protermify IT/DevOps as a static IT and DevOps reference page.

Definition

A visual indicator in files generated by version control systems during merge conflicts, marking the boundaries of conflicting code regions that must be resolved before a commit can proceed.

Operational example

When two team members edit the same file simultaneously, conflict markers appear in the file to highlight sections requiring manual resolution.

Localized term
